messages:
maria-ops: FYI customer reported a spike of 502/504s on the hosted inference endpoint (api.redwood.com/v1/generate) starting ~14:35 UTC. Affects a few large-embedding jobs. Sample trace: trace_id=01af9c, request_id=req-9b2c.

devon-platform: Can you paste a curl sample they used and any response body or headers? Also which edge cluster/region?

maria-ops: region=us-east-1, edge-cluster=edge-rt-7. Here's simplified repro curl from customer: 
``` 
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"<big-payload>"}' \n  https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings 
```
Response: HTTP/2 502
{"error":"upstream service error"}
Headers: x-request-id:req-9b2c x-trace-id:01af9c

jamal-sre: I pulled envoy logs for edge-rt-7 around 14:35. Seeing a pattern of upstream_reset and reset_due_to_connection_failure on long-lived streams. Example log: 
```
[14:35:22] envoy upstream reset: UPSTREAM_CONNECTION_FAILURE, stream_id=34567, upstream_host=10.2.8.21:8080
[14:35:23] envoy stream reset: RESET_FOR_CONNECTION_REPLACEMENT, downstream_stream=67890
```
Looks like h2 keepalive pool exhaustion + connection churn when big embedding requests open many concurrent streams.

devon-platform: Any recent config changes? Keepalive or max_concurrent_streams tweaks?

deploy-bot: deploy:edge-config-service v2.14.3 applied to edge-rt-7 at 2026-03-17T14:32:50Z by devon-platform (change: reduce upstream_idle_timeout from 120s -> 30s).

emily-support: P1 for this customer, they have live users waiting. Can we get a rollback or a fast mitigation?

jamal-sre: Rolling back the idle_timeout change is the fastest path. Short-term mitigation options:
- increase upstream connection pool size and h2 concurrent stream limits
- disable connection reuse for very large embedding payloads (route to dedicated path)
- throttle concurrent embed jobs at gateway for this tenant

devon-platform: I can rollback the idle_timeout patch to 120s on edge-rt-7 now. Doing a canary rollback to 2 nodes first.

jamal-sre: Also raising env var for envoy: upstream_max_concurrent_streams=200 (was 80) on the cluster. Applying now to canary nodes.

maria-ops: Customer confirmed reduced 502s after 14:42 UTC, still monitoring. Their last failing req id was req-9b2c at 14:36:11.

deploy-bot: rollback:edge-config-service v2.14.2 applied to edge-rt-7 at 2026-03-17T14:40:12Z by devon-platform.

jamal-sre: Metrics update: h2_active_streams peaked at ~950 at 14:35, dropped to ~120 after rollback. Error rate for /v1/embeddings on edge-rt-7 dropped from 6.8% -> 0.5% within 2 mins.

devon-platform: Created a short-term rate-limiter rule for embeddings to cap concurrent requests per-tenant to 12 while we investigate load shaping.

emily-support: Noted. I'll escalate to Customer Success and keep the customer posted. File an incident and post runbook actions.

maria-ops: Action items: (1) Incident doc + timeline, (2) add graph for h2_active_streams and upstream_reset rate per cluster, (3) plan longer-term: partition large embeddings to dedicated pool or autoscale pool for embeddings, (4) consider reverting upstream_idle_timeout changes across regions until we better simulate embedding workloads.

jamal-sre: I'll open the incident and assign follow-ups to devex for repro harness and dev infra for pool autoscaling.

devon-platform: Pushed a short runbook note to the edge-config repo: how to detect keepalive pool exhaustion and safe rollback commands.

maria-ops: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-314 opened by jamal-sre, priority=P1, affected=hosted-embeddings, start=2026-03-17T14:35:00Z

emily-support: Closing loop with customer once incident doc is ready.

jamal-sre: Follow-up: we should add traffic tests with large-embedding payloads to our preflight suite to catch this before config rollouts. :mag_right:
